name: outlook-classic-mcp
description: Mail, calendar and contacts of the classic Outlook for Windows — through the Outlook already signed in on your PC.
long_description: Talks to the running classic Outlook (Win32) via COM and uses its existing session: no Azure app, no Graph API, no tokens. Read, search and organize mail, write drafts and replies, manage the calendar, look up colleagues in the company directory. Nothing is sent: everything outgoing becomes a draft you review in Outlook. Every change is written to a local audit log.
